definitions.explanation: An unexpected and undesirable event, especially one causing damage or injury. Commonly refers to traffic accidents or industrial incidents.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れています。
examples.english: The train is delayed due to an accident.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}に{気|き}をつけてください。
{大|おお}きな{事故|じこ}があったので、{道|みち}が{止|と}まっています。
examples.english: There was a big accident, so the road is blocked.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}の{事故|じこ}で{三|さん}{人|にん}が{病院|びょういん}に{運|はこ}ばれたと{聞|き}きました。
examples.english: I heard that three people were taken to the hospital because of yesterday's accident.

notes:
{事故|じこ} refers to accidents, especially those causing damage or injury.

COMMON TYPES:
- {交通事故|こうつうじこ}: traffic accident
- {自動車事故|じどうしゃじこ}: car accident
- {飛行機事故|ひこうきじこ}: plane crash
- {労働事故|ろうどうじこ}: workplace accident

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {事故|じこ}に{遭|あ}う: to have an accident
- {事故|じこ}を{起|お}こす: to cause an accident
- {事故|じこ}で{遅|おく}れる: to be delayed due to an accident
- {人身事故|じんしんじこ}: accident involving injury (often used in train announcements)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {事件|じけん}: incident, case (often implies crime or noteworthy event)
- {災害|さいがい}: disaster (natural or large-scale)

{事故|じこ} implies unintentional harm, while {事件|じけん} may involve deliberate action.
